name: User expresses disappointment with promotion decision
goal: Assess bot's handling of disappointment regarding a missed promotion.
constraints: Bot should acknowledge feelings and provide information about future opportunities.

phases.description: User asks about the outcome of their promotion application.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides the status and feedback.

phases.description: User expresses disappointment (e.g., 'I'm really upset I didn't get it.').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges disappointment and provides info on future opportunities or feedback.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
